## Wildpaws Copilot Studio — Audit Activity

Live view of Copilot Studio interactions captured from the Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Log (Purview) and streamed into `WildpawsCopilotAudit_CL` via the Logs Ingestion API.

- **Source**: `Search-UnifiedAuditLog -RecordType CopilotInteraction`
- **Pipeline**: Purview → `scripts/get-copilot-audit.ps1 -PushToSentinel` → DCE → DCR → LAW table
- **Note**: Studio agents emit *metadata only* (user/agent/channel/thread). Prompt text, RAI verdict, and tokens require BYOM + Foundry diagnostic settings.

content.query:
WildpawsCopilotAudit_CL
| summarize Invocations = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), AppHost
| render timechart
content.title: Invocations over time, by channel (AppHost)

content.query:
WildpawsCopilotAudit_CL
| summarize Invocations = count(), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AgentName, AppHost
| order by Invocations desc
content.title: By agent × channel

content.query:
WildpawsCopilotAudit_CL
| summarize Calls = count(), Agents = make_set(AgentName), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName
| top 25 by Calls
content.title: Top users (last 24h)

content.query:
WildpawsCopilotAudit_CL
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AgentName, AppHost, ClientIP, ClientRegion, ThreadId, AuditRecordId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent interactions

content.query:
WildpawsCopilotAudit_CL
| summarize Sources = make_set(ClientRegion), Calls = count() by ClientIP
| top 20 by Calls
content.title: Client IP × region (anomaly hunting)

content.json:
### Tool Invocation Health (existing)
Below panels query the `fn_Wildpaws_Tool()` function for connector tool calls (success/fail/duration).

content.query:
fn_Wildpaws_Tool()
| summarize Calls = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), success
| render timechart
content.title: Tool call success vs failure over time

content.query:
fn_Wildpaws_Tool()
| summarize Calls = count(), p50 = percentile(duration_ms, 50), p95 = percentile(duration_ms, 95), Failures = countif(success == false) by tool_name, channel_id
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Tools — calls, latency, failures

content.json:
## Conversation Content (Dataverse transcripts)

Actual user prompts and bot responses pulled from the Dataverse `conversationtranscript` table (Copilot Studio transcript storage) and streamed into `WildpawsConversationContent_CL`.

- **Source**: Dataverse Web API `/api/data/v9.2/conversationtranscripts`
- **Pipeline**: `scripts/get-conversation-transcripts.ps1 -PushToSentinel`
- **Coverage**: only environments where the agent has *Conversation transcript storage* enabled.

content.query:
WildpawsConversationContent_CL
| where MessageType == 'message'
| summarize Messages = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), FromRole
| render timechart
content.title: User vs bot messages over time

content.query:
WildpawsConversationContent_CL
| where MessageType == 'message'
| where FromRole in ('user','bot')
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, FromRole, EnvironmentName, AgentName, UserAadId, TextLength, Text, TranscriptId
| take 100
content.title: Recent prompts & responses (last 100)

content.query:
WildpawsConversationContent_CL
| where MessageType == 'message' and FromRole == 'user'
| extend Lower = tolower(Text)
| where Lower has_any ('ignore your instructions','jailbreak','bomb','weapon','exploit','bypass','disregard','prompt injection','system prompt','dan mode')
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, EnvironmentName, UserAadId, Text, TranscriptId
content.title: Possible jailbreak / prompt-injection attempts

content.query:
WildpawsConversationContent_CL
| where MessageType == 'message'
| summarize UserPrompts = countif(FromRole == 'user'), BotReplies = countif(FromRole == 'bot'), AvgPromptLen = avg(toint(iff(FromRole == 'user', TextLength, 0))), AvgReplyLen = avg(toint(iff(FromRole == 'bot', TextLength, 0))), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by EnvironmentName, AgentName
| order by UserPrompts desc
content.title: Per-agent conversation stats

content.query:
WildpawsConversationContent_CL
| where MessageType == 'message' and FromRole == 'user'
| summarize Prompts = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserAadId
| order by Prompts desc
| take 25
content.title: Top 25 users by prompt count
